content.title: Latest News In Energy Transition - Greenbacker Sells Solar Portfolio to Altus Power
content.summary: In the ongoing advancement of the energy transition, Greenbacker Renewable Energy Company LLC has executed a significant transaction by selling a 237-megawatt solar and storage portfolio to Altus Power. This sale, featuring over 100 projects across 18 states, aligns with Greenbacker's strategy to emphasize larger utility-scale projects that enhance efficiency and create long-term value within the renewable energy sector.
